title: FlareEnough
tagline: Event-Based Options Trading Platforme. Options are only traded if your event occurs

prizes.title: MAIN TRACK: use protocols on Flare blockchain

description: FlareEnough is an event-driven options DEX built on the Flare network, allowing users to trade options based on real-world outcomes—not just time. Instead of a single expiry timeline, FlareEnough creates parallel markets tied to specific event results (e.g., “Trump wins” vs. “Trump loses”). Traders choose the reality they believe in, and only the timeline that matches actual events proceeds to settlement—others are discarded and refunded. Powered by Flare's FDC and FTSO
how_its_made: FlareEnough is built on the Flare network, leveraging its decentralized oracle system to securely fetch and verify real-world event outcomes. The platform deploys smart contracts that create separate option markets (or "timelines") for each possible outcome of a defined event. Users can buy or sell call and put options within the timeline they believe will come true. Once the event resolves, Flare’s oracle confirms the result, automatically settling trades only in the correct timeline while discarding others and refunding collateral.
